title: Beyond Procedure: Substantive Fairness in Conformal Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity in downstream decision accuracy improvement by computing the maximum Ratio of Odds Ratios (maxROR), along with prediction set properties (coverage and set size gaps), across age groups using the FACET image classification dataset with an LLM-in-the-loop evaluator.

Measuring substantive fairness via the maxROR metric for downstream decision accuracy improvement, as well as procedural fairness metrics (coverage and set size gaps), across binary gender groups on the BiosBias text classification and RAVDESS audio emotion recognition datasets using an LLM-in-the-loop evaluator.
Assessing disparities in downstream accuracy improvement (maxROR) and procedural metrics across different racial categories on the ACSIncome tabular dataset using an LLM-in-the-loop evaluator.
